issues.title: Course lesson videos not playing for students
issues.problem_statement: Some of the customer's students say the course lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones; the customer said this was the third time they had raised it.

items.description: Support opened the lesson link the customer shared on desktop Chrome, on Safari and on a phone, and the video played each time, so support could not reproduce the problem.
evidence: I've opened it on my desktop in Chrome and the video plays fine.
So I cannot reproduce the problem from my side.

evidence: I'll raise this with our technical team and get back to you.
I can't give you a timeline right now
